replacement_candidates.name: Acoustic Wave Obstruction Detection System
replacement_candidates.mechanism: Ultrasonic acoustic wave transmission through CSF shunt catheter. Changes in acoustic impedance indicate obstruction before flow reduction. Passive, no electronics in fluid path.
replacement_candidates.problem: CSF shunt obstruction (35% of failures, $42K per revision)
replacement_candidates.cemetery_compliance: Passes all 12 cemetery constraints — different mechanism class (acoustic, not membrane/yield/flow-gated/distributed/cellular/phase-change/self-referencing/kinetic/NO/variable-orifice/tau/glycan)
replacement_candidates.patent_novelty_hypothesis: Acoustic wave obstruction detection in CSF shunts — needs PatentBear verification
replacement_candidates.status: CANDIDATE — needs computational modeling + patent search

replacement_candidates.name: Magnetic Resonance Flow Quantification Sensor
replacement_candidates.mechanism: Miniaturized MR-based flow sensor integrated into shunt catheter. Uses nuclear magnetic resonance to quantify CSF flow without external imaging. Passive magnetic field sensing.
replacement_candidates.problem: Lack of continuous CSF flow monitoring (current methods require external imaging)
replacement_candidates.cemetery_compliance: Passes all 12 cemetery constraints — different mechanism class (magnetic resonance, not in any cemetery category)
replacement_candidates.patent_novelty_hypothesis: MR-based flow quantification in implantable shunt — needs PatentBear verification
replacement_candidates.status: CANDIDATE — needs computational modeling + patent search
